title: THE PIXEL HURT STATES
why: His picks a12 B (white then red hit with a recoil) and a13 D (red ink pulse, shoulders drop, stains at low health) from the art survey, and his 10-20 orders for the pixel art pass. Job 86g, ship 1: a hit and low health stay in the pixel body instead of falling back to the vector one.
now: A hit washes the pixel pillager white then red inside its own shape with a one pixel push; low health pulses the outline red and drops the shoulders one pixel with two stains.
